summary: Example of with_together using item.0 from the letters list and item.1 from the numbers list.

answer_card.title: with_together example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ item.0 }} and {{ item.1 }}"
  with_together:
    - ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']
    - [1, 2, 3, 4]
```
